**Issue #3518 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3518: Patch: the mutation audit of the web's layers and the Worker (apps/web, apps/edge), #3490 part 7
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### Kind

Architecture

### Why

#3490 part 4 for the TypeScript. Stryker's areas are `web-<layer>`, for Game.tsx's layers and the two adapters, and `edge`. File counts: animations 1, effects 231, audio 32, cards 160, drag 8, settings 11, wire 12, wasm 3, and the Worker 2. The Worker's first run scored 56.70%: 97 mutants, 55 killed, 15 survived, 27 with no coverage.

### What to change

Sort every survivor and every mutant with no coverage into one of #3490's four verdicts:
- **A test gap:** a test that asserts the value.
- **An equivalent mutant:** an `ignore` in its Stryker config or a `// Stryker disable next-line <mutator>: <reason>` comment.
- **Dead code:** remove it, after rule 13's check.
- **A real bug:** its own issue.

Give the components the edge-case `PlayerView`s #3490 lists: an empty hand, a full board, hidden cards, a pending choice. Fix or delete the tests that prove nothing, a snapshot that blesses whatever came out among them.

### Acceptance

- Each pull request carries #3490's table: one row per layer or file, with its mutants killed, survived and excluded, its score before and after, and a verdict and reason for each survivor left standing.
- Its layer's score rises.
- The five required checks are green.

### Blocked by, part of

Part of #3490. Blocked by #3511.

### Difficulty (a guess)

medium

### Priority

No priority

### Who does it

Decide later.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42748732561)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Sort every Stryker survivor and no-coverage mutant in the nine areas (`web-animations`, `web-effects`, `web-audio`, `web-cards`, `web-drag`, `web-settings`, `web-wire`, `web-wasm`, `edge`) into #3490's four verdicts — test gap, equivalent mutant, dead code, real bug — and resolve each accordingly. Add the edge-case `PlayerView`s the components lack, and fix or delete tests that prove nothing. Each area's score rises, and the pull request carries #3490's table with a verdict and reason for every survivor left standing.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/test/fixtures.ts` | change | Add missing edge-case views (`emptyHandView`, `hiddenCardsView`; verify `fullBoardView`, `pendingFor`, `waitingPending` first and reuse them) |
| `apps/edge/src/routing.ts`, `apps/edge/src/index.ts` | change | Fix survivors (15 survived + 27 no-coverage known); inline `// Stryker disable` only for proven equivalents |
| `apps/edge/src/routing.test.ts`, `apps/edge/src/index.test.ts`, `apps/edge/src/config.test.ts` | change | New tests asserting each survived value (routing prefixes, `precompressedModule` headers, wait constants) |
| `apps/web/src/game/animations.ts` | change | Fix its survivors; inline disables for equivalents |
| `apps/web/src/fx/**/*.{ts,tsx}` | change | Only files with survivors; tests colocated as `<name>.test.ts(x)` |
| `apps/web/src/audio/**/*.{ts,tsx}` | change | Only files with survivors (e.g. `director.ts`, `cues.ts`, `clockAlarm.ts`) |
| `apps/web/src/cards/**/*.{ts,tsx}` | change | Only files with survivors |
| `apps/web/src/game/drag/{cues,landing,model,targets,tilt}.ts`, `DragLayer.tsx`, `OptionDrag.tsx`, `BlockedMark.tsx` | change | Only files with survivors |
| `apps/web/src/settings/{store,tabs,slots,groups,motion,accountSync,controls}.ts` + panels | change | Only files with survivors |
| `apps/web/src/wire/{ai,aim,cards,catalog,codes,emotes,engine,index,json,rng,run,validator}.ts` | change | Only files with survivors |
| `apps/web/src/wasm/{index,useEngineReady}.ts`, `WhenEngineReady.tsx` | change | Only files with survivors |
| `apps/web/src/game/__snapshots__/Board.test.tsx.snap` + owning test | change | Replace bless-whatever snapshots with explicit assertions, or delete the test with reason |
| `apps/web/stryker.config.mjs`, `apps/edge/stryker.config.mjs` | change | Only to exclude a proven-equivalent whole file/class that cannot take an inline disable, with reason comment |
| `spec/pending/3518.md`, `spec/rulings/R3518xxx.md` | new | Only if a Hearthstone-semantics decision arises (next free R3518000+ number) |
| PR description | — | Carries #3490's table (not a file) |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; generated `apps/web/src/wire/generated/**`, `apps/web/src/wire/engineConfig.ts`, `serverConfig.ts`, `apps/web/src/wasm/pkg/**`; `spec/11-rulings.md` tail; `crates/`, `apps/edge` wrangler config. Governing spec: §10.8 (client renders `viewFor`, `PlayerView` contract); R190 ( Worker's `forServer`); rule 13 (dead-code deletion check).

## Steps

1. Read `apps/web/README.md`, `apps/edge/README.md`, and the header comments of both Stryker configs and `scripts/mutants.sh`. Run `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` once so the web tests load.
2. Baseline, smallest areas first (`edge`, `web-animations`, `web-wasm`, `web-drag`, `web-settings`, `web-wire`, then `web-audio`, `web-cards`, `web-effects` last): run `sh scripts/mutants.sh <area>` with `MUTANTS_OUT` default, then `sh scripts/mutants.sh score <area>`; record killed/survived/excluded and before-score. For `web-effects`/`web-cards`, work one shard at a time (`sh scripts/mutants.sh web-effects <k>`) and audit each shard before running the next.
3. For each survivor/no-coverage mutant, apply exactly one verdict: (a) observable behavior → test gap: add a colocated test asserting the value (copy `apps/edge/src/routing.test.ts` style: one `it` per behavior, real timers/values, no snapshot); (b) no observable difference (log text, `??` fallback that types make unreachable, `+ 0`) → `// Stryker disable next-line <Mutator>: <reason>` naming why no test could kill it; (c) dead code → delete only if nothing in or out of the tree calls it (grep callers; exported API shared with deploys or other services is rule 13: leave it and list it under Open questions in the PR); (d) real bug → do not fix silently: list it in the PR body for a person to file as its own issue.
4. Add missing fixtures in `apps/web/src/test/fixtures.ts` (`emptyHandView`: hand `[]`; `hiddenCardsView`: opponent hand face-down, backrow `faceDownBackrow`; reuse `fullBoardView` and `pendingFor` where they exist), following `emptySide`/`baseView(over)` override style. Use them in the new component tests for the layer under audit.
5. Prove-nothing tests: any survivor-area test with zero assertions or a snapshot that merely blesses output gets explicit `expect`s on the values the mutants change; if there is no value worth asserting, delete the test and name it with its reason in the PR table (the task orders this; it is not weakening a check to reach green).
6. After each area, re-run Stryker scoped to touched files (`cd apps/web && MUTANTS_OUT=target/mutants/<area>-after pnpm exec stryker run stryker.config.mjs --mutate <comma-paths>`; same in `apps/edge`), run `sh scripts/mutants.sh score`, and fill that area's table row: mutants killed/survived/excluded, score before/after, verdict + reason per remaining survivor.
7. Verify per area: `pnpm --dir apps/web test <each touched test file>`, `pnpm exec vitest run --project edge` for the Worker, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web`. If a ruling test was added, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Tests

- Worker: in `apps/edge/src/routing.test.ts`, `it("sends only /api and /ws to the server")`, `it("serves the compressed module with br encoding and wasm type")`, `it("keeps stored Cache-Control, adds it when missing")`, `it("passes 304/404 through untouched")`; in `index.test.ts`, `it("START_WAIT_MS stays under the client's API timeout")`. Run `pnpm exec vitest run --project edge`.
- Each test-gap survivor: colocated `<source>.test.ts(x)`, title stating the asserted value, e.g. `it("keeps the alarm's lead time at ALARM_LEAD_SECONDS")`. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test <file>`.
- Fixtures: extend `apps/web/src/test/helpers.test.ts`-style coverage — render `Board`/`Hand` with each new view and assert the edge case shows (empty hand renders no cards; hidden cards render backs; pending choice renders options). Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/test/helpers.test.ts` plus the component test files.
- Snapshot replacement: the rewritten `Board` test asserts named elements, then `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Board.test.tsx`.

## Done when

- [ ] Every survivor and no-coverage mutant in all nine areas has a verdict; test gaps have tests, equivalents have disables with reasons, dead code is removed (rule-13-safe) or escalated, real bugs are listed in the PR body.
- [ ] Missing edge-case `PlayerView`s exist in `fixtures.ts` and are used by component tests.
- [ ] Prove-nothing tests are fixed or deleted with reasons; no bare bless-output snapshot remains in audited areas.
- [ ] PR carries #3490's table: one row per layer/file (killed, survived, excluded, score before/after) plus verdict + reason per survivor left standing.
- [ ] Every layer's score rises (Worker rises from 56.70%).
- [ ] The five required checks are green; typecheck, eslint, and touched unit tests pass locally.

## Risks

- Stryker runs in place and rewrites sources; run on a clean tree and never interleave edits with a run. `web-effects` (231 files) is slow — shard it and never run the whole web at once.
- `vitest.stryker.config.ts` excludes source-reading tests from Stryker runs; those tests still run in CI — do not "fix" them for mutation score.
- Hidden-information rule: fixture views must be buildable from a real `viewFor`; if a component needs more, that is a §10.8 finding, not a fixture hack.
- Deleting code that looks dead but is called from outside the tree (routes, worker entry, container hooks) violates rule 13 — escalate, don't delete.

## Open questions

- #3511 (blocker) is unreachable from here; assumed it does not change the four verdicts or Stryker configs as stated in this issue — rebase the audit onto it if it does.
- Real bugs need a person to file their own issues, and rule-13 dead code needs a person's delete approval; both are listed in the PR body, not done by the builder.
- By the hardness rule's Big clause this is likely hard, not medium: test and disable edits across `fx` (231 files) and `cards` (160 files) can pass 40 files even when few survivors need tests.
```
